title: Qwen4-Max lands on @runware. Start building today! 🙌
text: Qwen4-Max lands on @runware. Start building today! 🙌 Runware@runware @Alibaba_Qwen Qwen4-Max is live on Runware 🧠 Alibaba's Qwen4 flagship takes text, images and video in a 1M-token context window, with configurable reasoning effort, function calling and JSON Schema output. - 1M-token context, up to 128K output tokens - Image and video input for screenshot, document and video analysis - Same price in thinking and non-thinking modes, one input tier up to 1M tokens - Call alibaba:qwen@4-max on /v1/chat/completions or /v1/responses from $1.50 per 1M input tokens, $4.50 output and $0.075 cached input Your browser does not support the video tag. 🔗 View on Twitter 🔗 View Quoted Tweet 💬42🔄16❤️370👀49702📊59 ⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
